newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian budget plans see $3 bln eurobonds in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Russian budget plans see $3 bln eurobonds in 1998.

text.p: Russian 1998 budget plans foresee $3 billion in Eurobond issues out of a total $9.6 billion foreign borrowing, Interfax news agency quoted First Deputy Finance Minister Vladimir Petrov as saying on Thursday.
Deputy Economy Minister Ivan Materov was quoted as telling the same cabinet meeting the average rouble exchange rate next year would be 6,180 to the dollar, according to government calculations.
Petrov said that deficit financing from domestic sources would be about the same next year as this year and total 97.4 trillion roubles, about one-fifth of the 1997 budget.

He said that foreign budget financing would include $3.6 billion of untargeted credits from international financial organisations, $1.2 billion targeted from foreign organisations and $1.8 billion of targeted credits from foreign governments.
